description: Reads a trip planned earlier with plan_trip, by the trip id it returned: its status and, when ready, its options with every labelled price and the link to each option on trip720.travel. Use it when plan_trip answered 'building', or to show a planned trip again. Read only: it changes nothing. Trips are kept 30 days; an unknown or expired trip id says so.
